headline: Cost Estimate for Flagship US Lithium Project Rises 31%
summary: Planned costs for a flagship U.S. lithium project rose 31% amid federal efforts to expand domestic production of critical minerals and lower reliance on China.
why: Lithium is a essential raw material for electric vehicle batteries and energy storage, central to national industrial policy goals.

impacts.name: Lithium
impacts.why: Higher development expenditures affect supply economics and project feasibility for domestic lithium extraction.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
